summary: Architectural & UX implementation plan to overhaul the Living Knowledge Studio into a GoodNotes / Apple Notes / Samsung Notes tablet workspace: completely removing SRS in favor of auto-tracked Neglected Sheets filtering, fixing all broken header/dock/theme/margin-rail handlers, adding instant finger/stylus brush-drag highlighting and masking, embedding a page-anchored stylus ink layer that scrolls with the sheet, and supporting copy-pasteable free-floating and inline resizable image/note blocks.
